headline: Am I meant to be alone now, or is there still time?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were face down, but your hand found the one whose table is still open.
The cup, coin, blade and wand are all still laid out.
You asked whether you are meant to be alone or still have time. What catches me is that open table.
Love has not come, and your question has narrowed to destiny or time.
Just as possibility should become connection, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing revealed him, yet you reached for the card that's still growing.
Living green leaves remain on the wood above him.
You asked whether the pause has a purpose or an end. This card makes me look at the life still present.
Still, you are alone, and the pause has started to feel like a designation.
Something stands between the living pause and the relationship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see the picture, but your hand went to the one already setting out.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked whether solitude is assigned to you. The light bundle holds my attention.
But no one has joined the road, and you are asking whether the chance remains.
The thing that has hold of the beginning keeps it from becoming a meeting. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
